name: window-check-presses-release-refused-late
description: A release that the host refuses with 1007 after host.buttons reports mask 0 leaves the press open, and the cleanup reports the press that stayed open with the text of the refusal.
reason: The case sends native pointer input and the refusal is the state of a person, so the replay cannot arrange it.

error.message: AppKit reports NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons mask 0x1 while com.apple.finder (pid 667) is frontmost
